notes: Outline redrawn 2026-11-20 under the owner's new rules (edge on paper between the innermost rule and the first map ink; ruled boxes at the margin are notches; no holes; legend/title blocks, compass roses and SECTION badges go in 'remove'). Sides: placed from pixel profiles across the frame at every px along each side (outer bar, white hairline, thin inner rule), on the first 1-2 px of paper inside the thin rule's inner edge, never on the rule or in the hairline; where map ink lies within a few px of the rule the edge runs in the paper gap between them, and where map ink truly touches the rule it follows the rule's inner edge (estimated from the neighbouring clean stretches and the bar's outer edge). Points every 15-50 px, so the bowed rules are followed. Kind (b): along the left side (y ~470-2700) lot and street lines and block edges run into the left rule; the outline follows the rule's inner edge across them and keeps to the 1-3 px paper gap where a line runs just inside the rule. A map line touches the bottom-left arc near (545, 3055). remove: (1) the CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP title, LEGEND and scale-bar block (top right, rectangle on blank bay paper); (2) the compass rose with north arrow, needle and tail (right, over the bay): the dashed pier-head/bulkhead line runs straight through the rose, so ~300 px of that map line lies inside this remove polygon (the block is taken whole); (3) the SECTION 10 badge (octagon on blank paper inside the top-right arc). All three kept unchanged from the former holes. No other holes; no ruled box at the margin. 'Join Sec. 9' (top) and 'Join Sec. 11' (left) print outside the frame bars. BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO, SOUTH BASIN and ISLAIS CREEK CHANNEL stay map.
